facts.fact: WAN-IFRA op-ed by Sellina Nyankowani Kainja says Malawi has an Access to Information Act overseen by the Malawi Human Rights Commission.
The op-ed says the Malawi Human Rights Commission oversees the Access to Information Act but received no funding for its activities in the 2022-2023 national budget.
The op-ed says the Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act of 2016 is in use against journalists and criminalises publishing 'offensive' content online.
facts.system: Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act 2016

MWI.note: The 2016 Act is described only as restricting online speech; no source statement on e-transactions or online selling.

facts.fact: The op-ed says Malawi24 journalist Macmillan Mhone was arrested in April 2024 and charged with extortion and causing public alarm after publishing an article accusing a businessman of corruption.
The op-ed says investigative journalist Gregory Gondwe was detained in April 2022 after reporting on government dealings with a businessman, and his equipment was confiscated.
